## Context / Problem
Observed 2026-08-15 while cutting the 0.12.0 release (ticket grassgreen-unfearful-quoll): `rebar review-plan` failed with `LLMConfigError: a bedrock model/provider is configured but no AWS region could be resolved`, returning an unsigned INDETERMINATE and no LLM pass. The overlap step failed the same way (WARNING rebar.llm.overlap.wire: store-wide overlap step failed).

Reproduction environment (this checkout, a fresh non-login agent shell):
- Env: only `AWS_PROFILE=frontier` exported — no `REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION`, no `AWS_DEFAULT_REGION`, no `AWS_REGION`.
- `~/.aws/config`: `[profile frontier]` has NO `region` key (login_session only); `[default]` has `region = us-east-1` but is shadowed by AWS_PROFILE=frontier; `[profile frontier-bedrock]` carries `region = us-west-2` + a credential_process chaining to frontier, but is not the active profile.
- Result: every resolution rung in the documented order (REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION > AWS_DEFAULT_REGION > AWS_REGION > boto3 profile resolution) comes up empty and the provider raises.

Prior art: closed bug saintly-letterhigh-yaffle (8274-6714-32b6-48be) added AWS_REGION to the env-var resolution order (the error message now lists it). That fix works but did not close THIS gap: env-var resolution cannot help a shell that exports none of the vars, and the active profile carries no region.

Root cause (residual): the repo config half is missing. `rebar.toml`'s `[llm]` table pins the Bedrock model IDs (region-scoped `us.` inference profiles, single-sourced from .github/llm-providers/bedrock.toml) but does NOT set `bedrock_region_name`, even though the knob exists (src/rebar/llm/config.py:476,599-600 — `_llm_str(table, cli, "REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION", "bedrock_region_name", None)`). The checkout therefore knows exactly which region its pinned `us.*` profiles live in, yet makes every operator/agent shell rediscover it via ambient env — fresh agent shells (Copilot/Codex tool shells do not inherit login-shell exports) fail closed on every gated operation.

## Approach
Set `bedrock_region_name` in rebar.toml's `[llm]` table to the region the pinned `us.*` inference profiles are served from (us-east-1 per the 2026-08-21 operator ruling — the project's measured region, superseding this paragraph's original us-west-2 proposal), so the checkout is self-sufficient: any shell with working AWS credentials runs the gates without per-command region injection. Env vars keep precedence (REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION overrides the table value) so nothing regresses for operators who pin a different region. Consider recording in docs/config.md that a repo that pins region-scoped Bedrock inference profiles should pin the region beside them.

## File impact
- rebar.toml — set bedrock_region_name in [llm]
- docs/config.md — note pairing region-scoped model pins with a pinned region (if guidance is missing)

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] rebar.toml's [llm] table sets bedrock_region_name to the region matching the pinned us.* inference profiles.
- [x] In a shell exporting only AWS_PROFILE=frontier (no REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION, AWS_DEFAULT_REGION, or AWS_REGION), `rebar review-plan <id> --status` and an LLM-bearing gate run resolve a region and do not raise LLMConfigError.
- [x] REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION env var still overrides the rebar.toml value (covered by an existing or new unit test).
- [x] ~~The verdict's provider provenance records the region and its source as repo-config.~~ Moved by operator ruling (2026-08-21, comment below) to follow-up task astatine-pixilated-shrimp (cda8-0f27-b324-4446, linked discovered_from): truthful region_source labeling needs source-metadata plumbing (LLMConfig.from_env collapses CLI/env/file into one string; resolve_bedrock_region labels every configured value as REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION) and is out of scope for this change.
